name: asfai-learning
description: Teach and plan with ASFAI, or connect PrivateDataPod and other Solid Pods directly through the bundled private-storage MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: ASFAI learning with built-in PrivateDataPod access.
interface.longDescription: Create and run lessons through chat, use the public ASFAI learning graph, and connect, read, or write PrivateDataPod and other Solid Pods through the included local MCP bridge. No separate Solid connector is required. Private credentials and signing keys remain on the user's device.
defaultPrompt: Connect my private Pod and continue my lesson.
Help me learn a concept and save my progress.
Create a lesson for my class.
